description: Create the dashboard project scaffolding: config files, entry point, type definitions, API client layer, custom hooks, and common/layout components. This establishes the foundation everything else builds on.
steps: Create dashboard/ directory with package.json listing: react 19, react-dom 19, react-router-dom 7, lucide-react, recharts, typescript 5.x, vite 6.x, @vitejs/plugin-react, tailwindcss 4.x, postcss, autoprefixer, @types/react, @types/react-dom
Create vite.config.ts with React plugin and proxy to localhost:8000 for /api
Create tsconfig.json with strict mode, path aliases (@/ -> src/), and tsconfig.node.json for vite config
Create index.html with root div and script module pointing to src/main.tsx
Create public/favicon.svg with a simple NEXUS-themed icon
Create src/index.css with Tailwind directives (@tailwind base/components/utilities) and global styles (dark sidebar colors, Inter font)
Create src/main.tsx mounting React app to #root
Create src/types/ with all type definition files: agent.ts, task.ts, company.ts, evolution.ts, common.ts - matching the backend response models (UUID ids as strings, datetime as strings, etc.)
Create src/api/client.ts - fetch wrapper with configurable BASE_URL defaulting to http://localhost:8000, error handling, JSON parsing, GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE methods
Create src/api/agents.ts, companies.ts, tasks.ts, workflows.ts, evolution.ts, budgets.ts - each with typed API call functions using the client
Create src/hooks/useApi.ts (generic hook with loading/error/data state), useAgents.ts (agent-specific), usePolling.ts (auto-refresh with configurable interval)
Create src/components/common/ - Card.tsx, Badge.tsx, Button.tsx, Table.tsx, Modal.tsx, Spinner.tsx, EmptyState.tsx, StatusIndicator.tsx

Create src/components/layout/ - Sidebar.tsx (dark #1e1e2e, navigation links with lucide icons), Header.tsx (breadcrumb, company info), Layout.tsx (sidebar + header + main content wrapper), Breadcrumb.tsx
acceptance_criteria: dashboard/ directory exists with all config files (package.json, vite.config.ts, tsconfig.json, tsconfig.node.json, tailwind.config.js, postcss.config.js, index.html)
All type definitions in src/types/ match backend response models
API client properly wraps fetch with error handling and typed methods
All 6 API module files exist with proper typed functions
All 3 hook files exist with proper React hook patterns
All 8 common components and 4 layout components exist with proper TypeScript interfaces
No any types used where avoidable
verification: Run node -c on key .ts/.tsx files to check basic syntax (or use tsc --noEmit if available)
Verify all files exist with correct directory structure using ls -R
Check that imports between files are consistent (e.g. api files import from types, hooks import from api)
